object_parameter_functions.comments: Scalar functions with an Object parameter get the external Java value of the column type. In the leaf stage the call runs in ScalarTransformFunctionWrapper, above a stage boundary it runs in FunctionOperand; for column arguments both must return the same result.

queries.description: jsonFormat on columns in the leaf stage
queries.sql: SELECT intCol, jsonFormat(intCol), jsonFormat(longCol), jsonFormat(floatCol), jsonFormat(doubleCol), jsonFormat(bigDecimalCol), jsonFormat(boolCol), jsonFormat(strCol), jsonFormat(bytesCol), jsonFormat(intArrayCol), jsonFormat(strArrayCol) FROM {tbl}

queries.description: jsonFormat on columns above a stage boundary
queries.sql: SELECT intCol, jsonFormat(intCol), jsonFormat(longCol), jsonFormat(floatCol), jsonFormat(doubleCol), jsonFormat(bigDecimalCol), jsonFormat(boolCol), jsonFormat(strCol), jsonFormat(bytesCol), jsonFormat(intArrayCol), jsonFormat(strArrayCol) FROM (SELECT * FROM {tbl} ORDER BY intCol LIMIT 10)

queries.description: toThetaSketch on a column in the leaf stage
toThetaSketch on a column above a stage boundary
queries.sql: SELECT intCol, toBase64(toThetaSketch(intCol)) FROM (SELECT intCol FROM {tbl} GROUP BY intCol)
